sourceRefs.locator: No. 22, beginning on p. 49: original AN K 4 no. 7; Corbery, competing claims of Saint-Denis and Sept-Meules, and dating by Childeric’s ninth year.
No. 2921, Paris AN K 4 no. 7: original parchment; opening line names Pippin and Attigny, the following pleading names Fulrad, Ragana and her representative, the conclusion dates by Childeric.
Section Childerich III, pp. 209–211, especially points b–f: the Soissons capitulary, the Wissembourg charter, the ninth regnal year on the Attigny original and the change of dynasty.
Julian and proleptic Gregorian leap-year rules: in June 751 and March 752 the Gregorian date is four days later.

labels.de: Pippin hört Fulrad als Hausmeier an
labels.en: Pippin hears Fulrad as mayor of the palace

note.de: Abt Fulrad beanspruchte Corbery für Saint-Denis. Pippin entschied den Streit am 20. Juni 751 als Hausmeier. Das erhaltene Pergament nennt Childerichs neuntes Königsjahr.
note.en: Abbot Fulrad claimed Corbery for Saint-Denis. Pippin gave judgment as mayor of the palace on 20 June 751. The surviving parchment dates the decision to Childeric’s ninth year.

original.conversionNote: The corresponding proleptic Gregorian date is four days later.
